name: Sivananda Yoga Centre Eilat
reason: Too thin under the health rule: the small site (sivananda-eilat.org; robots allows, Crawl-delay 10 honoured) has open classes and a free Sunday satsang, but its only course pages sell the beginners' yoga and meditation courses on conditions (blood pressure, back pain, depression, anxiety, attention disorders, sleep) and list only past dates (Dec 2025, Jan 2026); no prices, no email (contact form only), no teacher training. Fewer than ~3 clean items.
